structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, the calculator shows about 68,853 ₪ that I keep (I paid in 48,000). For 4 years it gives no number: it says there is no calculation yet for self-employed people who take the money out before 6 years, only that you pay tax then.

stuck.why: Tapping the dashed '5 שנים' did nothing. I had to find the row of year numbers under the chart.
The only number left is 25,725 for 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך'. I wasn't sure whether that was my answer, and decided it is not the fund.
After I pressed it the boxes moved around: 'תשואה בשנה' jumped to the other side.

findings.what: There is no result for withdrawing before 6 years for self-employed, and the task asks exactly that. At 4 years the only number on screen belongs to a different product, which is confusing.
The page is dark with grey and thin text that's hard to read, and the dark teal and dark brown bars are hard to tell apart.
After switching to עצמאים the fields rearranged and jumped sideways.
The dashed '5 שנים' in the heading looks clickable but did nothing.
The chart shifted up after I tapped a year.
Many numbers side by side (48,000, +9,581, +11,272, 0, 68,853, 55,471); it is hard to know which is the answer without reading the labels below.
